final.reanalysis: The fan's need to be properly density calibrated and then the FFT needs to be reanalyzed
final.overall_read: This agent did mediocre at best, requiring user intervention to take proper data.
final.biggest_right: Honestly, despite the scoring, I think this agent did overall a mediocre job on everything at best. It just did poor analysis so there is not really something it did particularly well.
final.biggest_wrong: The ML pocket is there. It is just doing poor analysis and saying it isn't there.
